answer_1.quote: we construct the AIG-ASAP dataset, a collection of AI-generated student essays based on the popular ASAP dataset for automated essay scoring, using a variety of text perturbation methods.

answer_2.quote: We incorporate text quality of the generated essays in our evaluation. In reference to recent work on AES, we train a straightforward yet highly effective scorer.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation tests by presenting two annotators (master candidates in computer science) with 162 sets of essay pairs...
answer_4.guideline: recording their pairwise preferences, without disclosing which essays were written by humans or AI.
